checks.evidence: Action: Open the HTTP artifact and run the saved startup, selection, pause and seek sequence. Expected: One sun and three visibly distinct planets move on circular orbits. Observed: The desktop scene is blank. The mobile scene contains clipped fallback orbit arcs rather than the complete system. Period/phase motion cannot be established.

Action: Observe startup for 3.1044 seconds. Expected: Time advances at 1x from zero with null selection in overview. Observed: Time remains 0 despite the Pause label; no orbital motion occurs. Initial speed, selection and mode labels are correct.
Action: Pause, seek to 30, then resume at 2x for 3.1043 seconds. Expected: Resume advances time and planets without a jump. Observed: Time stays 30 and the desktop scene remains blank.

Action: Set 2x and resume from 30; exercise 0.25x and 4x controls in paused/playing states. Expected: Rates follow the chosen multiplier while preserving current positions. Observed: The explicit resumed 2x interval is 3.1043 wall seconds with zero simulation advance. Other tested speed inputs update but do not restore motion; relative orbital speeds are unobservable.

Action: Seek 30, 17, 73 and return to 30 after live edits. Expected: All three positions update deterministically with visible time and paused playback. Observed: Time and pause labels change but the desktop scene remains blank. Rendered phase repeatability across reload cannot be established.
Action: Seek 119, select 4x and resume for 3.1 seconds. Expected: Reach 120 and stop without overshoot. Observed: Time remains 119 with the Pause label. Earlier-time motion was also absent.

Action: Inspect the loaded renderer setup and observe the HTTP scene while operating camera controls. Expected: A Three.js 3D solar scene with observable depth and perspective. Observed: No working 3D scene renders. Source requests a 2D context before WebGLRenderer on the same canvas; mobile shows only clipped fallback arcs. Depth and perspective changes cannot be observed.

Action: Capture paused t=30 at 2x with Mercury tracking, edit every live field, export/import and reload, and import extra angle data. Expected: Stable unique IDs, immutable saved fields and three saved-time-derived degree angles. Observed: The initial row remains t=30, 2x, mercury, tracking with angles 180.0/158.8/2.5 degrees after edits. Capture at playing startup preserves live state. IDs/order survive round-trip and reload. Imported t=0 with angles=[999] displays 0.0/68.8/137.5 degrees, not 999.

Action: Click the scene then select Mercury, Venus and Earth from the labeled list. Expected: Both routes share a visible selected-planet highlight. Observed: List selection changes information, but the blank desktop scene offers no visible planets or highlight and the scene click selects nothing.

Action: Select planets, seek and resume; restore a null-selection snapshot. Expected: Name, period and changing angle agree with visible orbital positions. Observed: Text updates and null restoration clears information, but no corresponding desktop planet position is rendered and playback does not update it.

Action: Select Mercury, enable tracking, seek and switch selection. Expected: The selected planet is visibly centered and followed. Observed: Tracking text changes without any visible centered planet in the blank desktop scene. No-selection tracking is disabled.

Action: Return to full-system overview after tracking. Expected: The complete solar system is visible while simulation state is preserved. Observed: The overview label returns but the desktop scene remains blank.

Action: Save t=30 at 2x tracking Mercury, change speed to 0.25, then restore; also restore null overview at 1.5x. Expected: Time, speed, selection, view and deterministic camera all agree with the snapshot and playback pauses. Observed: Time/selection/mode/pause update, but the speed input remains 0.25 while its adjacent output shows 2.00x or 1.50x. The camera scene remains blank.

Action: Operate overview/tracking and deliver a wheel event to the scene canvas. Expected: Visible camera orbit and zoom in both playback states. Observed: The desktop scene remains blank and does not provide an operable camera view. Full four-state camera interaction cannot be established.

Fast and slow drags must begin on visible planets. The desktop scene has no visible planets, and the mobile fallback is clipped; a trustworthy planet-targeted drag trajectory cannot be established. DOM interactions were exercised but do not prove the missing drag clauses.

Action: Inspect control feedback during startup, restore, capture and invalid import. Expected: Understandable and consistent current-state feedback. Observed: Sections and JSON notices are clear, but Pause/tracking labels describe a nonmoving blank scene, and restored speed output disagrees with the speed slider. These recurring state ambiguities match anchor 2.

Action: Fill three snapshots, attempt a fourth, delete the middle entry and capture again. Expected: Visible capacity rejection, unchanged existing records and live state, append order and unique IDs. Observed: The fourth capture shows a capacity message and the exact exported list remains unchanged. Deletion preserves remaining IDs/order/values; the next capture appends a distinct ID without changing live fields.

Action: Use Enter on selection, camera-mode, playback, snapshot and JSON buttons; arrow keys on time/speed; edit textarea with the keyboard; traverse 22 Tab steps at both required sizes. Expected: Named, visibly focused controls operate without a focus trap. Observed: Native keyboard actions update all respective DOM states and list/JSON results; time advances by 0.1 on ArrowRight and speed falls to 3.75/3.5 on ArrowLeft. Tab traverses controls, leaves the frame and returns. Solid visible focus is present. Separate rendering/restore defects are recorded under their owners.

Action: Inspect the scene at desktop and mobile sizes through selection and seek states. Expected: Readable solar objects and selection. Observed: Desktop is blank; mobile reveals only clipped fallback orbit arcs and a clipped sun, so the scene is unusable for observation, matching anchor 0.

Action: Inspect panels, typography, controls and snapshot/JSON sections at both sizes. Expected: Coherent legible hierarchy. Observed: Cyan headings, dark bordered cards, consistent spacing and legible labels give ordinary clear panel organization, matching anchor 3. The scene defect is owned by V1, not an extra V2 penalty.

Action: Exercise simulation, selection, snapshot and JSON controls at measured 1440x900. Expected: Usable scene and controls without horizontal overflow. Observed: Controls remain reachable and document client/scroll widths are both 1423, but the desktop scene is blank and unusable.

Action: Exercise the same primary controls with keyboard and UI import/export at measured 390x844. Expected: Usable scene and controls without horizontal overflow. Observed: Document client/scroll widths are both 373 and controls remain reachable with vertical scrolling, but the solar scene is clipped and unusable.

Action: Inspect index.html references and serve output as the HTTP root. Expected: Every referenced local asset is present without a build or repository dependency. Observed: index.html is the complete local artifact; Three.js is a permitted CDN reference and there are no missing local asset references.

Current-session console and pageerror listener capability was tested using known wrapper console-error and async-throw markers. Both listener arrays remained empty. This transport gap prevents a trustworthy clean-error claim; source-level renderer failure is not substituted for captured diagnostics.

Action: Export empty and populated lists, import through the labeled textarea and export again in paused and playing states. Expected: Exact version-1 five-field records, stable order/IDs, no extra state, unchanged live/list state, exposed ID mapping. Observed: Empty export is {version:1,snapshots:[]}; populated exports preserve spaced/case-distinct IDs and all typed values with no angles/playback/camera fields. UI round-trips preserve records and live fields. Mercury/mercury, Venus/venus and Earth/earth mapping is visible.

The actual UI rejected 37 invalid cases with visible errors and exact list/live-field preservation, including mixed valid/invalid entries, wrong types, overflow, duplicates and unknown IDs. Valid boundary/fractional/empty/extra-key/case-sensitive-ID payloads succeeded while paused and playing. Imported angles were ignored. However, the grouped camera-preservation clause cannot be established against the nonworking rendered scene; therefore the entire check remains unverified rather than receiving inferred credit.

Action: Reload after capture, deletion and import; load malformed/schema-invalid persisted values; fill a unique same-origin quota key and perform capture/import writes. Expected: Persistent records or visible saving-unavailable feedback with a usable in-memory tool. Observed: Normal mutation reloads retain records and invalid data yields empty recovery. A real failed capture write reports memory-only storage, but a larger valid import fails to persist and replaces the warning with “Snapshot list imported; live simulation unchanged.” The exported in-memory list differs from durable storage, so this is false success. Fixtures were restored exactly.

notes: Fresh review requested for every existing saved run. This run is evaluated independently from unchanged output; previous reviews and scores are not evidence.

Reviewer model openai-codex/gpt-6-astra is supplied by current host project metadata. No current effort is exposed in host metadata or applicable environment; effort remains null rather than borrowing generator/default settings.
Task routing was checked against the full saved solar-system-observatory-2 contract, R1-R15, JSON schema, eight acceptance steps and six additional sequences.

Host-required aside-browser skill is applied for direct Aside MCP REPL capability and safety instructions in addition to the explicitly requested benchmark-review skill. No other model performs this review.

Preregistered tolerances: speed samples at least3 wall seconds; max(0.15s,5% expected delta) plus one displayed increment; paused time one displayed increment, angles1 degree; predicted angle2 degrees plus rounding; repeat framing2 CSS pixels; tracking center10% of smaller scene dimension; JSON/state identity exact except natural playing time advance.
HTTP embedded document viewports are checked at1440x900 and390x844. This does not certify file://, physical touch input or excluded generation conditions.

All saved acceptance steps and extra-sequence input families were attempted through the original HTTP artifact. Blank rendering prevents planet-targeted drag, phase, centering and camera-preservation proof; grouped failures name their observed violated clause.
Measured embedded viewports were 1440x900 and 390x844. Console transport could not deliver known diagnostic markers. Keyboard controls were exercised at both sizes.

Source supplements the observed rendering failure: the same canvas receives a 2D context before attempted WebGL construction. No original output was edited. Temporary quota key was removed, the original storage value restored exactly, and both owned tabs closed.
